scope: One matched curriculum/control experiment, starting separately from unchanged own original foundation checkpoint.
objective: 0.5 assistant/EOS-only CE normalized over assistant targets + 0.5 existing TinyStories training-shard CE normalized over narrative targets.
curriculum: 50 batches of 8 reviewed short examples, then 150 batches from 62 reviewed Sol demonstrations.
control: Exact same SFT batch multiset shuffled across all 200 updates. Same narrative batches in the same step order. Models and fresh optimizer initialization identical.
selection: Among checkpoints with foundation NLL <=original baseline*1.05, maximize development correct+EOS turns, then EOS turns, then minimize dev NLL. Test never selects checkpoint.
success: Fresh test correct+EOS >=16/48, improvement >=8 turns over source baseline, EOS >=44/48, counterfactual pairs >=4/16, narrative NLL <=original baseline*1.05. Pilot progress thresholds, not general conversation acceptance.
regression_scope: A regression stops that arm; the other frozen arm can complete. Unequal completed exposure counts make an order-only causal comparison inconclusive.
heldouts: Fresh private synthetic probes, 16 development turns and 48 test turns. Test run at baseline and only once on each selected arm after both arms finish training. Agent-authored and inspected, not independent sealed benchmarks.
